scope: Complete native app visual system, iPhone shell, daily dashboard, secondary screens, forms, onboarding, empty states and widgets; preserve iOS 16 and product behavior.

type.display: Native SF sans, bold with tight spacing; large tabular score numerals.
type.body: Native SF sans with Dynamic Type; mono small data labels.
type.adaptation: System typography substitutes for source Inter/JetBrains Mono to preserve native scalability and offline installation.

geometry.cards: 24 pt outer corners, 16 pt internal controls; clean borders and shallow shadow.
geometry.controls: 44 pt minimum hit target; tactile face and compressed press shadow.
geometry.layout: Asymmetric score hierarchy, compact secondary stat cards, quiet settings rows.
geometry.dock: Intrinsic-width graphite capsule, amber active pill, 21 pt glyphs, 44 x 48 pt silent items, bounded to 343 pt; icons-only fallback for large text.

signatures: Accent primary score panel with restrained diagonal line motif from Stats Bento.
Flat thick circular score tracks adapted from Circular Progress Card, no liquid vessels.
Sliding selected-tab substrate and source-derived tactile controls.

motion.data: Immediate truthful numeric readouts; finite track-fill animation with a static reduced-motion final state.
motion.decorative: No continuously animated sky or liquid shader in the main dashboard.

previewEvidence.source: Actual code and demos retrieved and inspected; native screenshots will provide implementation QA.

rejected.name: Modern Minimal theme
rejected.reason: Blue primary too close to inherited dashboard identity.

rejected.name: Liquid WebGL CTA and glossy skeuomorphic switch
rejected.reason: Too costly and visually close to the liquid interface being replaced.

rejected.name: Dock v1 equal-width five labeled cells
rejected.reason: French labels were cramped and the surrounding frame too heavy at 375 pt.
